sections.title: Coming from a place
sections.content: You know *-ban/-ben* (in) and *-ba/-be* (into). The ending for 'out of' or 'from inside' is *-ból/-ből*: *a boltban* (in the shop) → *a boltból* (out of the shop). Ask *Honnan jössz?* (Where do you come from?) and answer *A boltból jövök.* (I come from the shop.) New words: *honnan* (from where), *pékség* (bakery), *cukrászda* (pastry shop) and *uszoda* (swimming pool).

sections.title: In and out of
rows: in the shop → out of the shop
in the school → out of the school
in the garden → out of the garden
in the restaurant → out of the restaurant

sections.content: A place that takes *-ban/-ben* ("in") takes *-ból/-ből* ("out of"). *Honnan?* asks for it.
